faqs.question: How do I book a room or family cottage?
faqs.answer: Send us a message on the Contact Us page or call our reception desk. We confirm availability right away.

faqs.question: Is breakfast included in the room rate?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every stay includes freshly prepared Ethiopian and international breakfast plus morning coffee in the garden.

faqs.question: Do you arrange Bole Airport pickup?
faqs.answer: Yes, our driver can pick you up from Bole International Airport any hour of the day or night when you share your flight time.

faqs.question: What are your check-in and check-out times?
faqs.answer: Check-in starts at 2:00 PM and check-out is by 11:00 AM. Early check-in or late check-out can be arranged when rooms are open.

newsPosts.title: New Two-Bedroom Garden Cottage Now Open
newsPosts.excerpt: More space for families and longer stays in Old Airport, Addis Ababa.
newsPosts.body:
We have opened a bright new two-bedroom cottage surrounded by fruit trees and seating areas in our main garden.

Families and visiting groups now have a private kitchen, living room, and direct access to morning breakfast service.
newsPosts.author: Selam Tadesse

newsPosts.title: Morning Coffee Garden Bar Welcomes Guests Daily
newsPosts.excerpt: Freshly roasted Yirgacheffe coffee and homemade pastries served every morning.
newsPosts.body:
Our sunny garden veranda now hosts daily morning coffee service with beans sourced directly from small farms in southern Ethiopia.

Guests can enjoy traditional jebena coffee alongside fresh bread, honey, and seasonal fruit before starting their day in the city.
newsPosts.author: Reception Team

newsPosts.title: 24-Hour Bole Airport Transfer Service
newsPosts.excerpt: Direct, reliable pickup and drop-off for all arriving and departing guests.
newsPosts.body:
Traveling to Addis Ababa is easier with our dedicated guest house shuttle.

Share your flight number when booking and our driver will meet you right outside the arrivals terminal.
newsPosts.author: Guest Relations

blogPosts.title: A Peaceful Weekend Guide to Old Airport, Addis Ababa
blogPosts.excerpt: Favorite local bakeries, quiet tree-lined walks, and family cafes minutes from our gate.
blogPosts.body:
Old Airport is one of the calmest residential neighborhoods in Addis Ababa, ideal for travelers who want clean air and quiet nights while staying close to the center.

Start your morning with fresh roasted coffee under our garden trees, then walk to nearby artisanal bakeries, green parks, and weekend craft markets.
blogPosts.author: Selamawit Kebede

blogPosts.title: Inside a Traditional Ethiopian Morning Coffee Ceremony
blogPosts.excerpt: How freshly washed green beans are roasted, brewed in a clay jebena, and shared with guests.
blogPosts.body:
At Garden Guest House, coffee is never rushed. Every afternoon we rinse green beans from Yirgacheffe, roast them gently over charcoal, and pour three traditional rounds.

Guests often gather on the veranda to meet travelers, plan day trips, and taste fresh toasted barley.
blogPosts.author: Birtukan Haile

blogPosts.title: Tips for First-Time Visitors Arriving at Bole Airport
blogPosts.excerpt: SIM cards, local currency exchange, and smooth check-in tips for landing in Addis Ababa.
blogPosts.body:
Arriving in a new city is much easier when your ride and room are ready.

If you share your flight time before boarding, our driver waits outside arrivals with a printed sign and brings you directly to your room in fifteen minutes.
blogPosts.author: Tewodros Bekele
